title: xerophyta brevifolia

This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Xerophyta brevifolia include inulin, sesquiterpenes, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
